smoke.detail: PG-SMOKE: FAIL AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: every migration in db/migrations must apply on real PostgreSQL, in order + actual - expected

reasons: verification_status must be one of ('INTEGRITY_VERIFIED', 'RESTORE_VERIFIED'), got 'RESTORE_FAILED'
storage_status must be exactly 'STORAGE_VERIFIED' (uploaded is not verified), got 'NONE'

notes: Parity gates on row counts and exact decimal SUMs per numeric column, discovered from pg_catalog; physical relation sizes are recorded as observations only (a live source accumulates dead tuples).
storage_status is NOT_NONE only after an uploader re-hashes the stored bytes (ADR-012); this drill does not upload.
